title: F-35 Got Hit
content_text: On March 19, an Iranian surface-to-air missile struck an F-35 during operations over or near Iran. The aircraft made an emergency landing. The pilot was reported stable. CENTCOM described it as an "emergency landing" and stated an "investigation is underway."…
